title: AppList
description: Installed-application inventory reported by MP Monitor via POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/apps. Triggered on enrollment and on ACTION_PACKAGE_ADDED / ACTION_PACKAGE_REMOVED broadcasts, or on receipt of a LIST_APPS command. The server caches the latest version; the Controller reads it to populate the app-picker UI.

inventory_version.description: Monotonically increments on every change. The device reports this in its heartbeat (monitor_state.apps_inventory_version) so the server can detect stale caches.

collected_utc_ns.description: UTC nanoseconds when this snapshot was collected on the device.

package_name.description: Unique Android package name (e.g. com.spotify.music). Key for all per-app config.

app_label.description: Human-readable label from PackageManager (e.g. Spotify). Display-only; may be ambiguous across packages.

uid.description: Android UID. Used internally for VpnService addAllowedApplication and getConnectionOwnerUid attribution; not logged in traffic.parquet.

is_system.description: True for system apps (ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM). Controller hides these by default.
